newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline gains $2-3, buyers try to hold back.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline gains $2-3, buyers try to hold back.

text.p: NWE gasoline was $2-3 a tonne stronger on Wednesday as buyers had to accept that prompt parcels are very scarce and expensive.
Firm NYMEX prices and bullish U.S. stocks data added to the trend for higher prices.
Dealers said as $206.00 fob Rotterdam traded for a first half eurograde barge with subsequent talk at $206-208 fob AR.
Cargoes were seen around $210 cif NWE for August material.
Swaps were stronger with August trading at $203.00 with September gaining $3-4 or so to $195, but still retaining its backwardation.
Supplies become more plentiful from August 15 onwards and most buyers were trying to hold out until then, traders said.
